Automation: Rules reference · play automation in progress

You leave a flickering likeness where your enemy expects to find you.

Rules

Action
Reaction
Attribute
None — no roll
Target / range / shape
Self, before a visible attack.
Duration
Resolve once at the stated trigger; applied conditions follow normal decay.
Equipment / acquisition
No item needed unless named above.
Limits
Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.
Type
Magic

A duplicate steps where you were. Gain 1 Boon to the defense, then move 1 square without provoking after the attack resolves. The duplicate vanishes immediately; it cannot absorb another attack.
